加入耀才
 招聘職位 
 System Analyst
 Responsibilities
To lead a small team for system development and ensure good quality of project deliverables
Responsible for full development life cycle (SDLC), including feasibility study, user requirements collection, development, UAT and implementation on mission critical trading applications, payment system and back-office settlement system
Perform application tuning and optimization
Provide user training and ad hoc support to business stakeholders
 Requirement & Qualification
Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related disciplines
Minimum 6 years of software development experience in Java, C#, .Net Core and Go
Minimum 3 years of experience in financial institution
Experience and knowledge in database SQL and tools (MSSQL and MySQL). Having database synchronization implementation is a plus
Sound knowledge of programming for REST APIs, socket programming, multi-threading and distributed N-tier client-server architecture
Knowledge of application security, authentication, and authorization concepts
Familiarity with Docker, cloud platforms, or CI/CD tools is an advantage
Familiarity with cloud-based application deployment and monitoring
Exposure to AI-enabled applications, data integration, or automation projects is a plus
Excellent interpersonal, communication and time management skill
Able to work independently and under pressures
Good command of written and spoken English and Chinese
Immediately available is preferred
 We offer competitive remuneration package to the right candidates.
 Application Methods
 Interested applicant should apply with detailed resume and present & expected salary by clicking "APPLY" and email to: recruit@bsgroup.com.hk
All information collected will be used for recruitment purpose only.
